# bun-cache

Bun's global package cache. Bun downloads packages again when needed.

**Name:** Bun cache · **Category:** Package caches · **Status:** stable · **Systems:** macOS, Linux, Windows

Upstream docs: <https://bun.com/docs/pm/global-cache>

**Detected when** one of `bun` is on PATH or one of `{cache}` exists.

## Paths

Resolved in this order: the tool's own command, then the environment variable, then the system default.

- `{cache}`: `$BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR` → default `~/.bun/install/cache`

## Locations

| Path | Item | Safety | Why | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{cache}` | Bun cache | Safe | This is a download cache; it is fetched again when needed (`REDOWNLOADABLE`) | `native:bun-cache-rm`, `quarantine` |

## Native commands

- `native:bun-cache-rm` runs `bun pm cache rm` (timeout 300 s, freed space measured before and after)
